subject: HSM Key Custody Snapshot and Rotation Log — Horizon SIG-Lite Submission
messages:
From: James Liu <james.liu@horizonbank.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@horizonbank.com
Date: Thu, 1 Feb 2029 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request — HSM custody + rotation logs

Hi Olga,

As part of our SIG-Lite assessment for Redwood's onboarding, we need a concise evidence package around HSM key custody and rotation. Can you provide the following by EOD 2029-02-07: 

- A snapshot export showing active key material (key IDs, algorithms, creation dates) for tenant-scoped keys used to encrypt customer data. CSV or Excel preferred.
- Rotation logs for all primary/signing/envelope keys from 2027-01-01 to present (audit timestamps, operator IDs, event types).
- HSM audit trail extract showing operator authentication events and key ceremony entries for the last 24 months (redactions allowed for operator usernames but please preserve role and timestamp).
- The current key custody model (who holds split-key/shares, escrow policy) and any BYOK handoff notes if applicable.

Preferred delivery: SFTP or secure cloud share (expiring link). If you have a canonical manifest file or an index of files we should expect, include that. Also indicate if any certificates/attestations are available from your HSM vendor.

Thanks — we want to get this into our control workspace before the SIG reviewers start next week.

Best,
James Liu
Lead Compliance Auditor
Horizon Bank

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: James Liu <james.liu@horizonbank.com>
Cc: audit@horizonbank.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Feb 2029 13:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request — HSM custody + rotation logs

Thanks James — we can deliver. High-level plan below, and a couple quick clarifying Qs so we provide the most usable exports:

Plan (deliver by 2029-02-04):
- hsm-keystore-manifest.csv (active key IDs, algorithms, creation dates, usage tags)
- rotation-log-2027-2029.zip (rotation events, operator id hashes, timestamps, prior/next key IDs)
- access-matrix-202901.pdf (current custodian roles and authorized principals)
- HSM audit trail slice (operator auth events) — included in the ZIP as audit-trail-2027-2029.csv

Clarifying Qs:
1) For rotation logs: CSV columns preferred are [timestamp, event_type, key_id_old, key_id_new, op_id_hash, comments]. Is that format okay?
2) Do you need the full HSM vendor attestation (we can include the Thales/Luna or AWS CloudHSM attestation PDF) or just the operational extracts?

We will provide an expiring secure link and will mask operator usernames to hashes but keep role mappings intact. Marissa will curate the access matrix; Karthik will pull the raw rotation exports from our gating cluster.

I'll follow up with the secure share link once the package is staged.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Feb 2029 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request — HSM custody + rotation logs

Olga / Karthik — internal coordination notes (action items):

- Karthik: pull rotation exports from RedKey-HSM-prod (path: /exports/hsm/rotation/2027-01-01_to_2029-02-01/). Please include both rotation-event.csv and operator-auth.csv. Replace operator usernames with SHA256 hashes; keep a separate mapping file internally (don’t send mapping to Horizon).
- Marissa: I will assemble access-matrix-202901.pdf (role -> allowed ops -> last-approval-date) and confirm the custodian list. I’ll also generate hsm-keystore-manifest.csv with the following columns: key_id, tenant_id (redacted as tenant-xx), algorithm, created_at, usage.
- Olga: reviewer-facing summary text (one-page) explaining rotation policy and emergency-rotation playbook.

Notes:
- We should exclude any ephemeral dev/test keys. Filter to production tenant keys only.
- Ensure rotation-log zip is signed (GPG sig) and include a small README that explains column formats.

Planned delivery: stage artifacts to a secure share under /secure/horizon/hsm-evidence-2029 and send link via encrypted email.

On Fri, Feb 1, 2029 at 1:42 PM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: James Liu <james.liu@horizonbank.com>
Cc: audit@horizonbank.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Feb 2029 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request — HSM custody + rotation logs

James — attaching the evidence package for your SIG-Lite reviewers. If anything is missing or you prefer a different format, let me know and we’ll iterate quickly.

Delivered artifacts (staged to secure share):
- hsm-keystore-manifest.csv (active keys, production tenants only)
- rotation-log-2027-2029.zip (contains rotation-event.csv, audit-trail-2027-2029.csv, README.txt)
- access-matrix-202901.pdf

Secure link (expires 2029-02-11): https://drive.redwood.ai/s/secure/horizon/hsm-evidence-2029
Password: (sent separately via 2FA)

Short sample from rotation-event.csv (redacted):
"timestamp,event_type,key_id_old,key_id_new,op_id_hash,comments"
"2028-11-03T02:34:12Z,rotation,k-4a9f3,k-5bc21,3f5a1d6e,scheduled-rotation-auto-policy"
"2028-06-17T14:11:05Z,emergency-rotation,k-311aa,k-8f004,7b2e9c44,compromise-response (no data exfiltration)"

Notes & attachments:
- We included a vendor attestation PDF from our HSM provider in the ZIP (vendor-attestation-2028.pdf).
- Operator usernames have been hashed; role mappings are documented in access-matrix-202901.pdf.
- rotation-log-2027-2029.zip is GPG-signed (signature file included).

Attachments: hsm-keystore-manifest.csv, rotation-log-2027-2029.zip, access-matrix-202901.pdf

Please confirm receipt and whether the SIG reviewers need additional context (e.g., playbook excerpts or a short walkthrough meeting).

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
